data.rationale: The proposal's first three steps (optional Filters/RV Site, type location, click FIND A KOA) match the true workflow, but it then adds a Rewards renewal and sign-in flow, campground selection and a second search click that don't belong, and it leaves the destination and dates ambiguously parameterized, so an automation built from it would be confusing and unreliable.
